name: program_registry
summary: Curated catalog of public Solana program IDs + Sui package IDs belonging to OTHER web3 apps (Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Pump.fun, Drift, Mango, Kamino, Solend, Magic Eden, Tensor, Gamba, Cetus, DeepBook, etc.). NOT our programs (TROLLN/SYNTH stay in .env). Drives program_monitor's subscription set. Each entry has chain, program_id, name, category, source_url, verified_at, watch:bool, notes. Storage: studio/assets/_program_registry/catalog.jsonl (append-only, key=chain:program_id).
engine_pattern: Plain stdlib JSONL persistence. Seed list of ~20 confirmed mainnet IDs (16 Solana, 2 Sui) covering 9 categories (DEX, DEX_AGGREGATOR, DEX_CLMM, DEX_ORDERBOOK, PERPS, LENDING, LIQUID_STAKING, NFT_MARKETPLACE, NFT_AGGREGATOR, MEMECOIN_LAUNCHPAD, CASINO, TOKEN_PROGRAM). watch=true by default except for system token programs which would flood. verify_format does base58 / 0x-hex checks (cheap, no RPC); a future verify-live mode would round-trip the RPC.
ethics_and_authorization: All program IDs are PUBLIC on-chain addresses anyone can observe via mainnet RPC.
Monitoring is read-only — no transactions are sent, no accounts are interacted with.
This is an oracle pattern: we listen to public chain state for signal-mining purposes.
Tom's own programs (TROLLN/SYNTH) deliberately NOT here; they live in .env.

inbound_callers: core/lib/program_monitor.py (reads watchset() to decide what to subscribe)
